name: seqrec-gpu
cmd: mkdir -p /workspace/seqrec; while true; do curl -fsSL https://github.com/sHyanorn/seqrec-lab/raw/main/scripts/cloud/pod_start.sh -o /run/seqrec-pod-start.sh && bash /run/seqrec-pod-start.sh >> /workspace/seqrec/runner.log 2>&1; sleep 60; done & [ -x /start.sh ] && exec /start.sh; exec sleep infinity
